messages:
Sam: FYI urgent — LumenVault provisioning has been stuck in 'finalize' since 13:12 UTC. Their onboarding call is at 14:00 and activation didn't complete. Opened ticket SR-8421.

Sam: Quick stack note: control-plane returned 502 in the final step, and retries show quota_exceeded when binding the provisioning pool.

onboard-bot: Ticket SR-8421 created by Sam. Priority: P1. Runbook linked: /runbooks/provisioning-failures

Dani: Looping in CS and Sales. @Raj can you confirm renewal date and ARR for LumenVault?

Raj: Renewal 2026-06-03, ARR $120k. Exec sponsor: Ana Park (CTO). If onboarding slips >1 week this account becomes high risk.

Maria: Investigating infra now. Early signal points to reserved GPU pool assignment failing — possibly a capacity-tag mismatch from yesterday's rollout.

Sam: Attached logs in SR-8421 show: "quota_exceeded: capacity tag not found". Retrying doesn't help.

Dani: Proposed immediate plan:
- Short-term: enable hosted fallback model for LumenVault so onboarding can continue.
- Mid-term: repair reserved-pool assignment and reprovision.
- Comms: prepare a customer note and internal alert to CSM, Sales, Eng-SRE, Infra.

Raj: Agreed. Wait up to 30m to confirm fallback before escalating to exec. Keep tone factual and calm.

Maria: I can flip to hosted fallback in ~18m. Need approval to bill hosted usage temporarily (will be cross-charged). Who signs?

Dani: I can approve the customer communication. @Finance can you OK cross-charge for fallback usage? cc: Raj

Raj: Sales ok with CS owning the message and temporary resource usage.

Finance: Approve up to $500 of hosted fallback cost without contract changes.

Sam: Implementation steps for infra:
```
1) customer.pool_override = "hosted_fallback_v2"
2) ./infra/provision --customer lumenvault --retry
3) watch /metrics/provisioning_success{customer="lumenvault"}
```

Maria: Applying step 1 now.

Dani: Drafting the customer note. Will send after hosted fallback confirms.

Dani: DRAFT to Ana (send after confirmation):
```
Hi Ana,

Quick update: we encountered an internal provisioning error when assigning your Dedicated pool during final activation. We've applied a temporary hosted fallback so your team can continue onboarding right away (no SDK changes required). We'll migrate you back to your reserved pool after we validate capacity and confirm the fix. Estimated timeline: fallback live immediately, permanent fix within ~48 hours.

We're treating this as a top priority and can join a quick validation call now if helpful. Sorry for the interruption.

— Dani, Customer Success
```

Raj: Tone looks good. Consider offering a small service credit if migration exceeds 72h — but don't promise without Finance sign-off.

Dani: Agreed — I'll offer an exec call and frequent status updates instead of committing credits.

Finance: Confirmed earlier — fallback usage approved up to $500.

Maria: Hosted fallback applied and reprovision retried. Metrics show provisioning_success spiked at 13:29 UTC.

Sam: Backend scripts now finish onboarding flows. Can we run a quick smoke test with the customer?

Dani: I'll invite Ana to a 15-min validation call in 10m. Internal standby: @Raj @Maria @Sam.

onboard-bot: Posted to #customer-success-alerts: LumenVault fallback applied (SR-8421) — please avoid destructive infra changes for 4h.

Ana (LumenVault): Thanks Dani — appreciate the fast turnaround. 14:10 UTC call works for us.

Dani: Sent calendar invite for 14:10 UTC with validation checklist and single-step SDK test link.

Sam: I'll be on the call to watch logs and rerun repro steps if needed.

Raj: I'll join in case the exec asks about roadmap/credits.

Maria: Postmortem tasks assigned:
- Infra: validate capacity-tag rollout and revert plan (Maria) — ETA 48h
- Eng-runtime: add guard on provisioning retries to avoid quota hits (Sam) — ETA 72h
- CS: update onboarding playbook with fallback procedure + templates (Dani) — ETA 24h

Dani: Customer is satisfied for now. Flagging SR-8421 as P1/monitoring until the permanent fix is complete. I'll send a proactive summary in 24h.

Sam: Will close the immediate support alert after the postmortem doc is published. SR-8421 -> mitigated, status: monitoring.

Maria: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
